newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial del Plata upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial del Plata upped.

text.p: ING Barings said Monday it was upgrading Argentine holding company Comercial del Plata to buy from sell.

Analyst Kathleen Breitenbach wrote in a report that the sale of certain assets announced Friday by Comercial to reduce its debt level was "very positive in terms of cutting financing costs and boosting future earnings."
She said ING Barings was estimating EPS of $0.23 ($2.35 per ADR) in 1997, excluding extraordinary gains.

"Our 12-month price target of 4.20 Argentine pesos per local share ($42.00 per ADR) implies a 20 percent appreciation from current levels and is based on our breakdown by business valuation which shows the stock trading at 14-20 percent discount," Breitenbach said.
On Friday Comercial del Plata said it expected to raise up to $330 million from three deals to sell interests in half a dozen Argentine companies.
The deals include the sale of petrol businesses to Astra, a subsidiary of Spain's Repsol, and of interests in construction and energy firms.
